verdict.rationale: Manufact hosts MCP servers on Manufact Cloud. Each deployment gets its own hosted MCP URL, and there are one-click installs or copy-paste configs for MCP clients, so developers manage no infrastructure themselves. A first-party Manufact MCP server also exposes platform tools to any MCP client. However, the developer must still deploy their own server code (from GitHub, a template, or the CLI) to get a URL with downstream tools; the docs do not show a ready catalog of hosted servers or a gateway that brokers third-party downstream tools without any deploy. The URL-connect option merely proxies a server already hosted elsewhere. Missing for 10: hosted access to downstream tools with zero deploy step, documentation of a gateway/proxy routing client calls to downstream tools, and independent hands-on corroboration of connecting a client to a hosted URL.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point my MCP-compatible client at a hosted remote server URL and reach downstream tools without deploying any infrastructure
